text:
Maya (CS): quick heads-up — several EU onboarding tenants hitting delayed embedding availability and occasional 5xxs during ingest window. Not platform-wide but enough to impact search during onboarding :frowning:
Luis (SRE): looking now. Preliminary: KV lock contention during concurrent backfills after yesterday's deploy. Seeing the retry storm on worker pool. Investigating rollback/mitigation options :mag:
Maya (CS): thanks. I'll start drafting a short customer note. Can someone confirm estimated recovery time? Need to tell customers whether to wait or request manual reindex
IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-4100001-EU-EMBEDDING — severity: medium — commander: Luis (SRE) — next update in 15m
Luis (SRE): mitigation applied: paused parallel backfills and switched to single-writer backfill per-region. Error rate dropped from ~7% to ~0.6%. Reindex backlog per tenant varies; median estimate 50-70 minutes. No evidence of data loss.
Aisha (Product): we should include a short non-technical explanation and an option for expedited manual reindex for customers in critical onboarding. Also propose a small goodwill credit for affected tenants in onboarding window.
Maya (CS): draft outbound snippet below — short and action-oriented. Please edit for tone/accuracy.

Hi [Customer],

We're reaching out because you may have experienced delays in embedding indexing for new data in our EU region between 2026-03-18 09:12 UTC and 2026-03-18 09:42 UTC. We implemented a mitigation and background reindexing is in progress.

What happened: concurrent reindex workers conflicted after a deploy which caused transient errors and delayed indexing. We've reverted the parallel writes and are processing reindexes sequentially to reduce errors.

What you may notice: search or similarity queries might temporarily return incomplete results until reindex finishes.

What you can do: no action is required. If you'd like an expedited manual reindex for your tenant, reply and we'll prioritize it.

We're also offering a one-time onboarding credit for tenants impacted during this window. Details will follow.

Thanks for your patience — please reply if you'd like us to queue an expedited reindex.

Regards,
Redwood Customer Success

Maya (CS): Sam, can you confirm approach for renewal-sensitive accounts? We want to call the top 5 in renewals and offer the expedited reindex + credit
Sam (AE): will do. I'll pull the renewal list and reach out to recommend the expedited reindex + 15% onboarding credit for those in 30-day renewal window. I'll DM Maya the list now
Luis (SRE): technical note for CS: reindex completion depends on tenant size. Typical small tenants finish ~30m, median ~60m, large up to 2h. If customers ask for an ETA, use median language and we will follow-up with per-tenant completion timestamps.
Aisha (Product): QA request: before we mark tenant as "reindexed", run a quick sample similarity check on 50 random vectors to ensure no quality drift. If drift detected, escalate to modelops.
Maya (CS): added feedback capture link to draft: https://forms.redwood.ai/eu-embed-incident-feedback — please include in the email so we can measure impact and suggestions
Luis (SRE): monitoring alert cleared but keeping incident open for 2h to watch reindex progress. I'll post per-tenant done timestamps into this thread as they finish
IncidentBot: INC-4100001-EU-EMBEDDING status: mitigated (single-writer backfill), monitoring. Next scheduled update 4100000072
Maya (CS): action items: 1) send outbound comm to impacted onboarding tenants (I'll send now) 2) offer expedited manual reindex for high-touch customers 3) AE outreach to renewal-risk accounts (Sam) 4) invite affected customers to office hours and collect feedback via form
Sam (AE): confirmed. I'll call the five renewal accounts after Maya sends the comm. If they accept expedited reindex, mark priority and note in this thread
Maya (CS): thanks all — will post the sent copy + list of tenants here. Please react with :white_check_mark: once you reviewed the comm
Luis (SRE): per-tenant updates incoming as they complete. Current backlog estimate ~45 minutes remaining overall.
Maya (CS): office hours link for customers: https://meet.redwood.ai/officehours-eu today 15:30 UTC — adding to comm
Aisha (Product): documented root cause in incident tracker: race during rolling deploy causing stale KV locks — follow-up: add mutex around reindex and improve deploy smoke tests
Maya (CS): sending now. Will report back with responses.
